fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-01-23 states that the complainant paid Rs. 4,50,000 as a processing fee for a promised loan that was never disbursed, on 2026-01-22 at roughly 15:25. The complaint was lodged by Chithra Devi (9000000176). The complaint refers to Dinesh Balan, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000363. The complainant mentioned the account SYN-ACC-100033 as the destination of the transfer. Mathan Velan (mobile 9000000147) was named as a possible person of interest. A witness, Abirami Sri, reachable on 9000000096, was mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned physical documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00174, as the mobile number 9000000147 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Agent reportedly claimed a guaranteed approval and became unreachable.
fields.Keywords: loan fraud, processing fee, receiving account, afternoon, associate, suspect, witness, documents
